title: cAMP Signaling Cascade
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: college placement Biology
description: Interactive step-through MicroSim of the GPCR-cAMP-PKA signal transduction pathway with amplification counter and PDE signal termination

learningObjectives: Trace the sequence from epinephrine binding through GPCR to cellular response
Explain how signal amplification occurs at each cascade step
Describe how phosphodiesterase terminates the cAMP signal

keyQuestions: Why does signal transduction use a multi-step cascade?
At which step does the greatest amplification occur?
What would happen if PDE were inhibited?
commonMisconceptions: The receptor directly activates the cellular response (it requires multiple intermediate steps)
cAMP is a protein (it is a small nucleotide derivative)
Signal amplification means the signal gets louder (it means more molecules are activated at each step)
assessmentOpportunities: Trace the complete pathway from ligand to response
Calculate the amplification factor across the cascade
